items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: Big Gasper and all of them, they were young musicians at the time.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. Some of those things would sell good now. They could make up the stuff.

Those things sell good. So I'm writing it. I'm writing it. And I don't know whether I orchestrate it or not because it's so hard to get an orchestra to. I like to have an orchestra to go over my way to see if I forgot something or if I want to put in something. Sometimes I might want to improve the phrase here or there. I might want to change the harmony just a little bit or place or another. You understand? Or I might want to put some little extra pep to it and so forth. Well, I was thinking about fixing that…
Yeah. Some of those were, I know.
